trigger.description: Create a service to handle webhook events from Slack

metadata.label: Event Channel
metadata.description: The type of Slack Events API event to listen for

section.label: Listener
section.description: Attach the service to a new or existing Slack webhook listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new Slack webhook listener in the project.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to a Slack listener already declared in the project.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing listener to attach the service to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Webhook Listener Port
metadata.description: The port on which the webhook listener accepts incoming HTTP requests

metadata.label: Listener Config
metadata.description: Fallback empty value for the listener config record when no fields under it are set.

metadata.label: Signing Secret
metadata.description: Signing secret of your Slack app, used to validate incoming Slack event requests

metadata.label: App
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack app is received. Available actions: onAppMention, onAppUninstalled, onAppContextChanged, onAppDeleted, onAppHomeOpened, onAppInstalled, onAppRequested, and onAppUninstalledTeam.

metadata.label: Channel
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack channel is received. Available actions: onChannelArchive, onChannelCreated, onChannelDeleted, onChannelHistoryChanged, onChannelLeft, onChannelRename, onChannelIdChanged, onChannelShared, and onChannelUnshared.

metadata.label: Do Not Disturb
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack do not disturb is received. Available actions: onDndUpdated and onDndUpdatedUser.

metadata.label: Email Domain Changed
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack email domain changed is received. Available actions: onEmailDomainChanged.

metadata.label: Emoji Changed
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack emoji changed is received. Available actions: onEmojiChanged.

metadata.label: File
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack file is received. Available actions: onFileChange, onFileCommentDeleted, onFileCreated, onFileDeleted, onFilePublic, onFileShared, and onFileUnshared.

metadata.label: Grid Migration
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack grid migration is received. Available actions: onGridMigrationFinished and onGridMigrationStarted.

metadata.label: Group
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack group is received. Available actions: onGroupClose, onGroupHistoryChanged, onGroupLeft, onGroupOpen, onGroupRename, and onGroupDeleted.

metadata.label: Direct Message
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack direct message is received. Available actions: onImClose, onImCreated, onImHistoryChanged, and onImOpen.

metadata.label: Link Shared
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack link shared is received. Available actions: onLinkShared.

metadata.label: Member
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack member is received. Available actions: onMemberJoinedChannel and onMemberLeftChannel.

metadata.label: Message
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack message is received. Available actions: onMessage, onMessageMetadataDeleted, onMessageMetadataPosted, and onMessageMetadataUpdated.

metadata.label: Pin
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack pin is received. Available actions: onPinAdded and onPinRemoved.

metadata.label: Reaction
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack reaction is received. Available actions: onReactionAdded and onReactionRemoved.

metadata.label: Star
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack star is received. Available actions: onStarAdded and onStarRemoved.

metadata.label: User Group
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack user group is received. Available actions: onSubteamCreated, onSubteamMembersChanged, onSubteamSelfAdded, onSubteamSelfRemoved, and onSubteamUpdated.

metadata.label: Team
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack team is received. Available actions: onTeamDomainChange, onTeamJoin, onTeamRename, onTeamAccessGranted, and onTeamAccessRevoked.

metadata.label: Tokens Revoked
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack tokens revoked is received. Available actions: onTokensRevoked.

metadata.label: User Change
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack user change is received. Available actions: onUserChange.

metadata.label: Assistant
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack assistant is received. Available actions: onAssistantThreadContextChanged and onAssistantThreadStarted.

metadata.label: Call
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack call is received. Available actions: onCallRejected.

metadata.label: Entity
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack entity is received. Available actions: onEntityCommentsRequested and onEntityDetailsRequested.

metadata.label: Function
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack function is received. Available actions: onFunctionExecuted.

metadata.label: Invite
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack invite is received. Available actions: onInviteRequested.

metadata.label: Shared Channel
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack shared channel is received. Available actions: onSharedChannelInviteAccepted, onSharedChannelInviteApproved, onSharedChannelInviteDeclined, onSharedChannelInviteReceived, and onSharedChannelInviteRequested.

metadata.label: User
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack user is received. Available actions: onUserHuddleChanged, onUserProfileChanged, onUserStatusChanged, onUserConnection, and onUserGuestStatusChanged.

metadata.label: Agent
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to Slack agent is received. Available actions: onAgentSessionStopped and onAgentSessionTitleChanged.
